ORDINANCE XV OF 1992
ORDINANCE XV OF
1992
LAHORE DEVELOPMENT
AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1992
An Ordinance
further to amend the Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 11th April, 1992]
No. Legis. 3(XV)/92, dated
11-4-1992.--The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the
Punjab is hereby published for information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Lahore Development
Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 1992.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall take effect on Lahore Development Authority (Amendment)
Ordinance, 1992 (II of 1992) of stands repealed under Article 128(2) of the
Constitution.

Addition of section 4-A in Act XXX of 1975

LAHORE DEVELOPMENT
AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1992
An Ordinance
further to amend the Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 11th April, 1992]
No. Legis. 3(XV)/92, dated
11-4-1992.--The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the
Punjab is hereby published for information:--
2. Addition of section 4-A in
Act XXX of 1975.--(1) In the Development Authority .Act, 1975 (XXX of
1975), hereinafter referred as the said Act, after section 4, the following
section 4-A shall added:--
"4-A. Vice-Chairman.--
(1) The Government may designate a member as Vice-Chairman of the Authority.
(2) The Vice-Chairman shall
perform such functions as may be assigned to him by the Authority."

Amendment of section 7 of Act XXX of 1975

No. Legis. 3(XV)/92, dated

3. Amendment of section 7 of
Act XXX of 1975.--(1) In the said Act, in section 7, for subsection (2) the
following shall he substituted:--
"(2) The meetings of the
Authority shall be presided over by the Chairman and in his absence by the
Vice-Chairman and in the absence of both by a member of the Authority elected
for the purpose by the members present, from amongst themselves:"
